top_non_tuning_diagnoses.name: long_peak::peak_obvious_and_ignored
top_non_tuning_diagnoses.diagnosis: Peak was visible and value loss after peak was material before close.

top_non_tuning_diagnoses.name: drawdown::dead_early_no_recovery
top_non_tuning_diagnoses.diagnosis: Extended drawdown cases often fail to recover, indicating dead-early holds.

top_non_tuning_diagnoses.name: drawdown::timing_tolerance_pattern
top_non_tuning_diagnoses.diagnosis: Recovered trades still spend excessive time in drawdown, suggesting tolerance leakage.

first_behavior_change_to_test_later.proposal: Test an earlier exit trigger when post-peak delay exceeds pair-specific p75 while loss_after_peak_pips >= 1.0.
first_behavior_change_to_test_later.why: Top leak counts concentrate in long peak-to-close delay and prolonged drawdown tolerance.

paper_trials.title: Post-peak delay guardrail
paper_trials.hypothesis: When post-peak delay exceeds pair p75 and giveback is at least 1.0 pip, value leakage dominates late exits.
risk_notes: Must verify no pair asymmetry in high-momentum tails.

paper_trials.title: Dead-early drawdown fail-fast
paper_trials.hypothesis: Trades that remain in deep drawdown beyond p75 with no recovery signal are low-probability holds.
risk_notes: Recovery classifier definition must be frozen before any simulation.
Could conflict with continuation patterns in volatile windows.

paper_trials.title: Drawdown tolerance cap
paper_trials.hypothesis: Recovered winners with prolonged drawdown indicate tolerance leakage that can be capped with minimal edge damage.
risk_notes: May reduce upside on mean-reversion recoveries.
Needs pair-by-pair false-cut accounting before promotion.
